references.title: HY OAS vintage export interface
references.author: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
references.supported_claim: Nominal vintage selection; sampled exports remain truncated and do not supply intraday capture timestamps.

references.title: ALFRED release and revision semantics
references.author: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
references.supported_claim: Archive updates can follow releases; source/provider release date and FRED first-availability date are distinct alternatives.

references.title: Bond Index Methodologies, April 30 2025
references.author: ICE Data Indices
references.supported_claim: Page 72: valuation timing; pages 6-7: possible delayed/suspended publication and case-by-case restatement. Valuation time does not establish HY OAS distribution time.

references.title: ICE Index Platform full-access overview
references.author: ICE Data Indices
references.supported_claim: Official historical download capability. Target OAS field, requested history, revision records and entitlements are not verified by the public overview.

references.title: FRED observations API specification
references.author: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
references.supported_claim: Realtime/vintage query semantics. No configured FRED API credential used in this task.

references.author: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
references.supported_claim: Vintage dates alone do not supply per-observation intraday publication timestamps.
